order: Address five findings from the latest review pass on the round-two code, while confirming that every round-one and round-two closure still holds. Make the reserve gate evaluate the requested rung so a degradation recast can never silently satisfy a stop condition, and disclose restrictions on every turn served through a fallback path. Replace the collapsed regular-expression glob matcher with a token-based dynamic-programming matcher, since separated wildcard runs broke the collapsed regex. Run output redaction before tail truncation so straddling credentials cannot leak a partial suffix. Install the trappable signal set on Windows, where one termination signal is untrappable, and document that startup pruning is the recovery path there. Remove literal NUL bytes left in the router source. Also exempt record documents from a lint by filename prefix, and separate a review-lane test case from interference by a genuine external tool installation already present on the host machine. Record the review verdict verbatim in the roster.
claims: The reserve gate now evaluates the requested rung so a degradation recast never silently satisfies a stop, with restrictions disclosed on every fallback-served turn; glob matching moved to a token-based matcher after the collapsed regular expression broke on separated wildcard runs; output redaction now runs before tail truncation; Windows installs the trappable signal set with startup pruning documented as the recovery path there; and stray NUL bytes were removed from the router source. The verdict was recorded verbatim. Suites: router 134, verifier 92, registry 31, full CI-equivalent run green.
